name: A server-added cosmetic pet appearance is sent to the client, summons its demon and dresses it as a mirror image
contract: coa_cosmetic_pet_appearance adds wardrobe rows the client's Appearances.dbc lacks. Each is sent when the client reports its extension is ready (CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED, 0x561): first its creature as SMSG_PATCH_CREATURE (0x567), which the client checks before applying a cosmetic pet, then the row as SMSG_PATCH_APPEARANCES (0x692) with display type APPEARANCE_DISPLAY_TYPE_CREATURE, the layout the client's own handler reads (17 fields, then the type string).

Row 640200 is a Summoned Demon (category 34) whose token is item 9707100 and whose creature is 11000300 (family 146). Applying it summons that creature as the Hero's demon, like any Summoner's Stone. A server-added appearance's pet is named after its creature; a client appearance's pet keeps its family's name, as before.

Creature 11000300 has a creature_display_preset, so it is drawn as a mirror image: the server sets UNIT_FLAG2_MIRROR_IMAGE and, for the pet's GUID too, answers CMSG_GET_MIRRORIMAGE_DATA with the preset's race, face, hair and gear. Its weapon is the creature_equip_template's virtual item. The token is sent as SMSG_PATCH_ITEM_ADDON (0x569), so the wardrobe can name it.

A cosmetic pet is saved as created by its kind's summon spell, not the taming channel: the core treats a pet whose creating spell has a duration as temporary, so it would not be restored at login and would come back from a recall without its spells or action bar.

steps.label: Let login hooks settle
The client reports its extension is ready
The creature is sent to the client
The server-added appearance row is sent
Enslave Demon Abilities
SETUP: Summon Demon known
Apply the server-added Summoned Demon appearance
The appearance is accepted
Its demon is the pet
A server-added appearance's pet takes its creature's name
The pet uses the preset's model
The pet is drawn as a mirror image
The pet can be abandoned and renamed
Dismiss Demon
SETUP: dismissed
Summon Demon calls the saved demon
The saved demon is back
The loaded demon is a mirror image as soon as it is out
The loaded demon keeps the preset's model
The recalled demon keeps its action bar
The demon is out again after logging back in
The demon keeps its action bar after logging back in
The demon is still a mirror image after logging back in
The token's name and source are sent to the client
